midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

signal-coral.$description: Signal Coral — Accent links, inline emphasis, illustrative highlights — vivid warm coral that cuts through the pastel system

merlot.$description: Merlot — Decorative icon accent, tag text, secondary brand touch — deep wine magenta used sparingly for typographic and icon moments

forest-floor.$description: Forest Floor — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

ember.$description: Ember — Card backgrounds, warm tag fills, soft section washes — pastel coral sibling of Signal Coral

coral-mist.$description: Coral Mist — Soft card surface, badge fill — near-white coral wash for warm category cards

sky.$description: Sky — Card accents, illustration strokes, icon highlights — vivid blue used as a cool counterpoint in the pastel palette

sky-mist.$description: Sky Mist — Gray supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

mint.$description: Mint — Card accents and illustration strokes — vivid electric green used as playful punctuation

mint-mist.$description: Mint Mist — Soft green card surface — pale mint wash for category cards

butter.$description: Butter — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

buttercream.$description: Buttercream — Pale card surface, subtle section wash — cream yellow

lilac.$description: Lilac — Decorative icon and illustration accent — vivid violet used in flat graphics

lilac-mist.$description: Lilac Mist — Pale lilac card surface — wash for cool category cards

blush.$description: Blush — Decorative badge fill, soft pink wash — mid-saturation pink

blush-veil.$description: Blush Veil — Pale pink card surface and badge background

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills

bone.$description: Bone — Alternate card surface, subtle section background

shell.$description: Shell — Warm-tinted card surface, badge fill with coral undertones

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted icon stroke, secondary text, illustration outline — neutral gray for graphic line work

cream.$description: Cream — Warm section wash — pale cream surface for alternating bands

feature.$description: Display and headline serif; used at 80px for hero statements, 54px for section openers, 38px for sub-sections, and 20–28px for editorial card titles. Custom high-contrast serif with extremely tight tracking (-0.030em at display) that gives headlines a magazine-cover confidence rather than a typical SaaS shout.

abc-rom.$description: Primary body and UI sans; weight 450 for body copy and buttons, 500 for subheads, 700 for emphasis. Tight tracking (-0.010em) gives it a compact, typeset quality — it sits close to the serif without competing.

abc-rom-mono.$description: Code snippets, technical labels, and monospaced micro-copy. Same tracking as ABC ROM (-0.010em) so it aligns visually in mixed-type compositions.
